Author:     Michael Weghorn <m.weghorn@posteo.de>

CommitDate: Wed Dec 24 12:04:17 2025 +0200

    Bug 2005900 - a11y: Set "aria-pressed" for "Keep duration" button. r=arschmitz
    
    
    Set the "aria-pressed" state [1] for the
    "Keep the duration when changing the end date" button
    in the dialog to create/edit an event or task.
    
    This causes it to be exposed as a toggle button on the accessibility
    layer (see [2]), and the current state is made available to
    assistive technology like screen readers.
    This e.g. makes the Orca screen reader on Linux announce the
    button as "toggle button" that's either "pressed" or "not pressed",
    making clear whether or not the option to keep the duration is
    currently active or not.
    (Previously, it was only announced as a "button" without any state,
    so it was unclear to screen reader users whether the option
    was currently active or not.)
    
    [1] https://w3c.github.io/aria/#aria-pressed
    [2] https://w3c.github.io/aria/#button
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D276352

diff --git a/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.js b/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.js
index 4415bd0d7a4..9afd5343d2e 100644
--- a/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.js
+++ b/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.js
@@ -1066,6 +1066,7 @@ function toggleKeepDuration() {
   // To make the "keep" attribute persistent, it mustn't be removed when in
   // false state (bug 15232).
   kdb.setAttribute("keep", keepAttribute ? "false" : "true");
+  kdb.setAttribute("aria-pressed", keepAttribute ? "false" : "true");
   document.getElementById("link-image-top").setAttribute("keep", !keepAttribute);
 }
 
diff --git a/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.xhtml b/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.xhtml
index 33b720fc13a..08df8a6e3d1 100644
--- a/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.xhtml
+++ b/calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-iframe.xhtml
@@ -378,6 +378,7 @@
                 oncommand="toggleKeepDuration();"
                 persist="keep"
                 keep="false"
+                aria-pressed="false"
                 tooltiptext="&event.dialog.keepDurationButton.tooltip;"
               />
             </vbox>
